# Changelog

## v1.0

First public release.

- Complete adventure: nine chapters, eight medals, the League, the Hall of Legacy and the credits.
- 150+ original creatures ("Elementis"), original map, characters and music.
- Four languages: Spanish, English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese (pick one on first launch, change it any time in Options).
- Four-level grayscale on the 1-bit screen by temporal flicker.
- Turn-based battles with trainers and wild creatures, items, status effects, evolutions, the PC box, the Registro, the trainer card and a casino.
- Music and sound effects on the speaker, with an Off switch.
- Experimental infrared link: trade creatures and fight exhibition battles between two Flippers.
- Built for the official firmware 1.5.1 (API 88). Momentum and Unleashed need their own build (see README).
